node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-double affine-color compiler
node.statement: The ordered m=8 three-color role resultant descends, through the depressed-cubic affine invariant, to seven explicit characteristic-zero affine color shapes. Every h=7 cubic 2+2+2 packet satisfies the resulting homogeneous color equation, leaving four equations in (x,q,d) on the generic branch after eliminating b.
node.notes: Exact necessary color compiler only. The full homogeneous resultant is the safe equation; its primitive characteristic-zero squarefree radical has the printed degree-seven polynomial. Reflection does not merge the two scalene conjugate pairs. No unit verdict is supplied.
